notes.title: Hirogami is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[p]We are [b]so[/b] excited to finally share Hirogami with the world![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="LBclwM6DNzo;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
[/p][p]To our wonderful growing community: thank you so much for the support and enthusiasm you’ve shown Hirogami throughout development - we couldn’t have made it this far without you, and we’re so excited for this game to finally be in your hands. 💖[/p][p]
[/p][p]If you’re new, here’s what awaits you in Hirogami:[/p][p]🌸[b] A beautiful origami world to explore [/b]- or as we like to call it, a papercraft paradise![/p][p]🌸 [b]Unique animal transformations[/b] - armadillo, frog, ape, and bird forms to play with![/p][p]🌸 [b]Platforming puzzles galore[/b] - crash, leap, swing, and soar through countless levels of fast-folding action![/p][p]🌸 [b]Soothing Japanese soundtrack[/b] - immerse yourself in a relaxing soundscape featuring traditional Japanese instruments as you explore the world of Papyrunia![/p][p]
[/p][p]We’ll be keeping our eyes and ears open for your thoughts and feedback, so please be sure to share your screenshots, favorite moments, and more on Steam and social media![/p][p]
[/p][p]If you encounter any pesky bugs or crashes, please fill out our [b][u][url="https://forms.gle/i8RJtQbPWezU6F6m9"]Bug Report Form[/url][/u][/b] and we will do our best to address any issues we see. Thank you![/p][p]
[/p][h2][b]From our crew to you, thank you for everything.[/b][/h2][h2][b]We hope you enjoy Hirogami. 🌸💖[/b][/h2][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45219306/980cfa21c704c285064dfe340b384c9c051eb494.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Devlog #2: Meet the Characters of Papyrunia
notes.content:
[h1]Hello again, heroes! 👋[/h1][p](Get it, like… Hiro? I dunno, we’re trying it out. If you have community nickname ideas, leave them below!)[/p][p]
We’re back with another developer diary for you all, and this time we sat down with [i][b]Hirogami[/b][/i][b]’s Lead Game Designer Yi Han Yong[/b] to discuss the character designs and inspirations behind [i]Hirogami[/i]. Let’s get to it! 🌸[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45219306/980cfa21c704c285064dfe340b384c9c051eb494.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Crafting a [strike]Hero[/strike] Hiro:[/b] Papyrunia’s Protagonist[/h2][h3][b]Can you tell us about how the design for Hiro came to exist? Were there any specific inspirations? Any ideas you liked but didn’t use in the end? [/b][/h3][p][b]YI HAN YONG: [/b]Hiro’s visual design came from our attempts to balance look and function, [b]following the superbly-designed concept art from our Art Director, Gary Choo![/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Following the creative brief to borrow a lot of inspiration from Japanese and East Asian cultures, [/b]Gary considered the in-game abilities of Hiro, ensuring the design wouldn’t be in the way of the actions. For example, there were a few iterations originally, and one of them was to give Hiro a really long scarf! It looked super cool, but we scrapped it in the end to keep the silhouette simpler and keep Hiro’s transformations swift.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45219306/7e2ed1021c8b79d610bc6b910dec41544418184d.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Speaking of those transformations, how did you decide on the four animals Hiro can transform into? Were there other possibilities that didn’t make the cut?[/b][/h3][p][b]YI HAN:[/b] For most part, gameplay came first, really! We brainstormed a lot on what kind of gameplay would benefit by the ability to transform at will, then we kind of narrowed that down to specific actions that Hiro can do, and what kind of challenges can be solved by those actions. After that, we worked backwards to figure out the appropriate animal forms for each action.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45219306/62777f05006d7ec9a961a82e363fd5d5a29c0644.png"][/img][/p][p]At some point we also considered non-animals forms, like giant mecha, weaponry, and other fun silly things, but [b]in the end we stuck with animals as they strike that sweet spot between gameplay, whimsical appeal, and of course, origami art![/b][/p][p][/p][p]We (okay, well, [i]I[/i]) also wanted a cat form, too! But in the end, we all agreed that a cat would just be too OP for everything, hahaha![/p][p][/p][h2][b]Sculpting the Supporting Cast:[/b] Friends and Foes[/h2][h3][b]Let’s talk about the supporting characters - Shiori, Ruz Pappy, Ama Jii, etc. - where did they come from?[/b][/h3][p][b]YI HAN: [/b]So before we designed the characters’ visuals, we already had the narrative outline set up. [b]The supporting characters complemented Hiro’s own personality and helped make sense of his character development throughout the game. [/b]Gary (the same Art Director from before!) and Wendell, our sole 3D Character Artist, worked together to combine all of that with their lovely artistic touches to bring the characters to life.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45219306/1c815a98176c4a948c61b166d511c1deeb48b352.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]What about the enemy and boss designs in [i]Hirogami[/i]? [/b][/h3][p][b]YI HAN: [/b]I’d answer that, but it would spoil too much! 😉 In short, they’re deeply inspired by [b]the theme of tension between natural, organic creativity and soulless, cold digital precision.[/b][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Is there anything about the overall character design process you’re excited to discuss that we haven’t asked you about yet? [/b][/h3][p][b]YI HAN: [/b]Animation! Beyond just [i]looking[/i] like something that belongs in an origami world[b], we tried to make the characters animate like that, too.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45219306/047e0d63ac58e423103619066f83e3fa0707295b.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Our awesome animators put in a lot of effort to bring the characters to life - not only in the obvious ways, but also in the subtle (and adorable!) movements, like idle animations, that sell the charm of the characters and their world. The process even included a bit of stop-motion animation to really nail that handcrafted feel![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Last, but not least… Of all the characters your team designed for [i]Hirogami[/i], who would be your favorite?[/b][/h3][p][b]YI HAN: [/b]Each of us has our own favorite! I can’t say too much for now, except that many of us feel like the badass Shiori (fiery friend to Hiro) deserves her own adventure someday! 😄[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45219306/21caae1369e3f03ddd64ec12cf9eced046908953.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45219306/980cfa21c704c285064dfe340b384c9c051eb494.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We hoped you enjoyed this peek into the pages of [i]Hirogami’[/i]s character designs! Do you have a favorite character yet? Let us know in the comments below! 💖[/p][p][/p][p]That’s all for now, but we’ll see you again soon when we delve into the details of [b]sound design! [/b]🎵🎶 Thanks for all of your continued support, and[b] don’t forget to wishlist [i]Hirogami [/i][/b]to be ready for launch![/p][p][/p][h2][i][b]Hirogami[/b][/i][b] launches on PC & PS5 September 3rd, 2025![/b][/h2][h2]Until then, follow us on socials for more updates:[/h2][h2][url="https://x.com/kakehashi_games"][u]Twitter / X[/u][/url] | [u][url="https://bsky.app/profile/kakehashigames.com"]Bluesky[/url][/u] | [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@kakehashi.games"][u]TikTok[/u][/url][/h2][h2]
[/h2]

notes.title: Devlog #1: Unfolding the History of Hirogami
notes.content:
[h3]Hi everyone, and welcome to [i][b]Hirogami[/b][/i][b]’s first ever devlog![/b] 🌸[/h3][p]I’m Ariana (hello!!! 👋), the Communications Director for [i]Hirogami[/i]’s publisher Kakehashi Games, and I’ll be the vague disembodied voice behind these posts. (I promise I won’t haunt your computer or anything.)[/p][p][/p][p]As we steadily inch towards [i]Hirogami[/i]’s launch date ([b]September 3rd!!! AHHH!!![/b]), we thought it’d be fun to share more about the characters, world, and development with you all, [b]featuring Q&A sessions with the developers themselves. [/b](We know it’s more exciting to hear from them, anyway!)[/p][p][/p][p]Starting today, you can expect a new developer diary to be published [b]roughly every two weeks[/b], full of inspirations, challenges, concept art, and more - so grab a snack, get cozy, and let’s dive in![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45219306/980cfa21c704c285064dfe340b384c9c051eb494.png"][/img][/p][h2]
[b]The Adventure Unfolds:[/b] How [i]Hirogami[/i] Began[/h2][h3][b]So, where did [i]Hirogami’[/i]s development start?[/b][/h3][p][b]YANDHIE PRATOPO (Hirogami Creative Director): [/b]Bandai Namco Studios Singapore (BNSS) had been around for over a decade (primarily supporting other projects) but we never had the chance to develop an original title of our own. When GYAAR Studio (indie label within BNSS) introduced the “Full Game Challenge”, we saw it as the perfect opportunity to showcase our team’s creative potential and prove what we were capable of! [/p][p][/p][p]Although the resources were limited and the team had to operate with an indie spirit, we embraced the challenge. The core development team remained small (less than seven people permanently attached to the project throughout the entire dev cycle!) but being part of BNSS meant we could call on support from other colleagues during quieter periods of their other assignments. [/p][p][/p][p]With the backing of our publisher, Kakehashi Games, and the determination to overcome all odds, we managed to bring [i]Hirogami[/i] to life.From several ideas, [b]our imagination was immediately sparked by the vision of an origami world,[/b] and the rest is history![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45219306/5cf3709639706a605ab71c835eda4d2e6aff0639.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]What are some of the inspirations behind [i]Hirogami[/i]?[/b][/h3][p][b]YANDHIE: [/b][i]Hirogami[/i] draws inspiration from a blend of traditional Japanese aesthetics, origami symbolism, and our love for action-adventure games with emotional cores. We were particularly influenced by the idea of fragility as strength, like paper that folds, bends, and transforms without breaking. That theme shaped not only the visuals, but also how Hiro evolves as a character![/p][p][/p][p][b]We wanted the world, Papyrunia, to feel handcrafted yet otherworldly, mystical yet grounded. [/b]Those contrasts became a constant guidepost throughout development, from level design to narrative beats to the flow of combat, and more![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45219306/82081595e074589ddd694011b82797445d8b7220.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Papercraft Passion:[/b] Why [i]Hirogami[/i]?[/h2][h3][b]What is it about Hirogami that excites you the most?[/b][/h3][p][b]YANDHIE: [/b]For us, it’s seeing how all the pieces fold together—pun intended, haha! The transformations, the expressive animation, the layered environments… it all feeds into this feeling of discovery and grace.
[/p][h3][b]And what about the players, what’ll excite them?[/b][/h3][p][b]YANDHIE: [/b]We think players will love the depth behind the combat and movement, but also the small moments. A quiet glade, an unexpected relic, a line of dialogue that hits just right… [b]there’s action, yes, but also heart, mystery, and a world that remembers your touch.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45219306/0d80435b259e51eb968bf011d7bf4d21a7fbb46f.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Hiro-ic Hopes:[/b] A Message to the Players[/h2][h3][b]Last question for today… How do you hope players feel after experiencing Hirogami for themselves?[/b][/h3][p][b]YANDHIE: [/b]We hope players walk away feeling that beauty can come from brokenness, and that even a fragile thing can fight back, adapt, and protect. [i][b]Hirogami[/b][/i][b] is ultimately about resilience, memory, and healing. [/b]The characters are folded by their pasts, just like Hiro, but they still choose to rise! If players feel even a flicker of that message, if they pause to reflect, or smile at a small detail, then we’ve done our job.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45219306/bdd1e8e633bfe1efc304f44834c6f55900190621.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45219306/980cfa21c704c285064dfe340b384c9c051eb494.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for reading, everyone! 🌸 We’ll see you again soon to share more insights behind [i]Hirogami[/i] - [b]next time, we’re talking all things character design![/b][/p][p][/p][h2][i][b]Hirogami[/b][/i][b] launches on PC & PS5 September 3rd, 2025![/b][/h2][h3]Remember to wishlist here on Steam to be notified at launch! Until then, follow us on socials for more updates: [u][url="https://x.com/kakehashi_games"]Twitter / X[/url][/u] | [u][url="https://bsky.app/profile/kakehashigames.com"]Bluesky[/url][/u] | [u][url="https://www.tiktok.com/@kakehashi.games"]TikTok[/url][/u][/h3]

notes.title: New Hirogami trailer! Origami Armadillos, Frogs, Apes, and more!
notes.content:
We're super excited to reveal more of the story and world of Hirogami, by way of a new character-full trailer!

Debuting during The Mix X Kinda Funny Spring Games Showcase 2025, the new trailer introduces the player character, Hiro, who has the unique ability to transform into origami animal forms. 

[previewyoutube=u182Mhfrb0I;full][/previewyoutube]

The trailer also introduces the revered elder armadillo, Ama Jii, the distinguished gentleman frog, Bingley, and the fearless mighty ape, Shaan Ti - each of whom Hiro will meet on the adventure to save their fragile origami world.

By rescuing these friends from a mysterious digital Blight, Hiro is able to unlock unique traversal and combat abilities.

[list]
[*] As a hardy armadillo, Hiro can roll through barriers and enemies alike - and can fire out of cannons to reach new areas
[*] As a nimble frog, Hiro can jump higher or slow down enemies or contraptions with intoxicating spit.
[*] And as a mighty Ape, Hiro can dish out a combo of sweeping attacks, swing from vines and pound the ground to scatter enemies. 
[/list]

The adventure unfolds in Hirogami, later in 2025. You can check out the Steam store page/wishlist below:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3135840/Hirogami/

notes.title: New 3D platformer Hirogami is coming for Astro Bot's crown
notes.content:
Selfishly, I want more triple-A-backed 3D platformers. We're not left wanting in the indie scene - A Hat in Time, New Super Lucky's Tale, and the upcoming Rollin' Rascal are all truly brilliant - but we don't get 'mainstream' entries in the genre that much anymore. Of course, there's Astro Bot, Crash Bandicoot 4, and Ratchet and Clank, but I want even more new ideas. In walks Hirogami, a stunning new platformer with some a neat premise, and we (hopefully) don't need to wait long to play it.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: An origami adventure unfolds in Hirogami!
notes.content:
Say hello to [b]Hirogami[/b], a brand new origami-inspired 3D action platformer from the development team at Bandai Namco Studios Singapore and published by us here at Kakehashi Games!

From a team comprised of industry veterans - with production, design and art credits on the likes of Ace Combat 7 and Tekken 7, among others - Hirogami invites you to a world where everything has been crafted to convey the physical, often fragile, nature of paper!

[previewyoutube=sdf1777C7V8;full][/previewyoutube]

In Hirogami, you'll explore a beautiful origami world as Hiro, a fan-wielding master of the art of ‘folding’. On your adventure you’ll explore every nook and cranny to discover hidden secrets, unfold into a sheet of paper to ride fiery updrafts, or become a paper plane to cross dangerous chasms.

You can also discover new forms to help you navigate the world, solve puzzles, and best your foes. Roll through obstacles and enemies alike as a hardy armadillo, traverse the treetops and pound pests as a mighty ape, and leap to previously unreachable heights as a formidable frog.

And everything is encompassed in a soothing soundscape - composed using traditional Japanese instruments and styles - specially crafted to evoke the variety of themes, characters and settings.

[b]Hirogami will ‘unfold’ onto Steam later next year.[/b]

Until then, follow [url=https://x.com/Kakehashi_Games]@Kakehashi_Games[/url] on Twitter for updates - and be sure to wishlist the game!

Thank you for your support!
